notes.title: Retiring Chrono Shift
notes.content: [p]Hello Chrono-Shift fans! After careful consideration, our company has decided to discontinue the development of Chrono-Shift and remove it from the Steam Store. Unfortunately, our employees have responsibilities elsewhere and have realized that we will not be able to develop Chrono-Shift into a game that we will be satisfied with. We greatly appreciate the support and feedback this community has shown, and we sincerely apologize for the discontinuation of Chrono-Shift.[/p]
